pk.context: 10 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

clues.kinetics: Well absorbed, and food does not affect absorption. It is 93% bound to plasma proteins and cleared mainly by direct glucuronidation and cytochrome P450 oxidation.
clues.substance: Molecular weight 312.44. It is a crystalline solid that is practically insoluble in water.
clues.product: An NDA product in 2.5 to 20 mg tablets, with doses adjusted in 5 mg steps once daily.
clues.safety: Boxed warning for increased mortality in elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis. No contraindications with monotherapy; postural hypotension and weight gain are common.
clues.indication: Treatment of schizophrenia in adults and adolescents, and agitation with schizophrenia or bipolar I mania when given by injection.
clues.mechanism: Its action is unclear, but efficacy may come from combined dopamine and serotonin type 2 antagonism.

tell: An atypical antipsychotic with a long, variable half-life (21 to 54 hours) and no contraindications with monotherapy.

evidence.pk.tmaxH: reaches peak concentrations in approximately 6 hours following an oral dose
evidence.pk.halfLifeH: Its half-life ranges from 21 to 54 hours (5th to 95th percentile; mean of 30 hours)
evidence.pill: The ZYPREXA 2.5 mg, 5 mg, 7.5 mg, and 10 mg tablets are white, round
